task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write sentences that are short and concise.
Write sentences that are relatively long and detailed.

axes.name: detail_density
axes.description: 문장당 포함된 단어 수로 표현되는 정보 밀도 수준입니다.

values.instruction: Use fewer words per sentence to keep information density low.
Use many words per sentence to convey detailed information.

axes.name: hedging_frequency
axes.description: 불확실성이나 추정 표현을 사용하는 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Avoid hedging and state facts directly.

axes.description: 답변 내 단락 수와 구성 방식을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Organize the answer into multiple paragraphs.
